operation.title: Multiply rational polynomials
operation.description: Compute the exact product of two rational polynomials in the same QQ variable ring. Sparse convolution admits at most 1000000 input term pairs; compact univariate products can instead use a dense backend with output span at most 4096 and a coefficient bit-work bound.
